buildRequirements: Teen and parent builds come from one exact approved repository head.
Teen build uses the preview profile and teen app variant.
Parent build uses the parent-preview profile and parent app variant.
Both builds target the dedicated alpha Worker and beta audience.
Build identifiers, platform, creation time, expiration, distribution list, and installation results are retained.
No production profile or production backend target is used.

checks: focus visibility on web when applicable
screenshots and app switcher do not reveal unnecessary private content
notifications reveal no raw private teen content
second-user sign-in reveals no first-user cache
deep links cannot bypass role, relationship, or auth gates
upgrade from prior preview when applicable
app variant and backend identity visible in retained evidence

requiredEvidencePerRun: screenshots or recording using synthetic data
stopConditions: Wrong app variant or backend target is installed.
A role or relationship gate can be bypassed.
Raw teen content appears in a parent surface, notification, log, or artifact.
Revocation, sign-out, deletion, or second-user isolation fails.
The app reports success during an unconfirmed network or mutation failure.
A crash, inaccessible critical route, or unrecoverable state blocks the journey.
Production routing or public distribution is used.
approvalGate: Founder approval is required before consuming paid build capacity, distributing preview builds, using controlled accounts, or collecting live device evidence.
nonClaims: This matrix is preparation, not a build or device result.
No device, operating system, installation, accessibility, or failure-state proof has executed.
